content: Adjacent prose linters, all dev-only, none zero-dep: Vale 3.15.2 (2026-07-23) is a single Go binary - no Node deps, but a separate non-npm binary download per platform, and no ASD-STE100 style package exists in its registry. Node/npm options are retext-simplify 8.0.0, retext-passive 5.0.0, retext-readability 8.0.0 on retext 9.0.0/unified 11.0.5; write-good 1.0.8; alex 11.0.1; textlint 15.7.1 - all MIT, all pulling large dependency trees. proselint and LanguageTool are Python/Java respectively. None encodes STE. All of them violate the zero-runtime-dependency rule if shipped to hosts; only a hand-written stdlib TypeScript guard in the existing guard family satisfies it.
